verdict.rationale: Lovable documents leaving with your code: you can download the codebase, sync it to a GitHub or GitLab repo you own, and deploy outside Lovable. However, nothing in the evidence documents exporting the rest of your data (database contents, auth users, storage files) in open formats. The SQL editor gives direct database access and the backend is Supabase-based, but neither is a documented export path. missing for 10: documented export of database data, auth/user records, and storage files in open formats, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete migration off Lovable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: If you only need a copy of your code, you can download your code directly from Lovable: use the Download codebase section in Project settings → Git
you can export and sync your project to GitHub: back up your code, review changes in pull requests, work locally in your IDE, test features on branches, and deploy outside Lovable
Git sync connects a Lovable project to a repository you own on GitHub or GitLab, and keeps the two in sync automatically
Code: Your app's source code, which you can browse, edit, and download.
